traits.life_span.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus (Mosyakin & Robertson) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs, usually annual, rarely perennial; FOC herbs annual.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus (Mosyakin & Robertson) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus (Mosyakin & Robertson) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves alternate, petiolate; FOC the same.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus (Mosyakin & Robertson) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves alternate (spiral, as the order's default; no flora names the pattern).

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus (Mosyakin & Robertson) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): margins usually entire, plane, slightly undulate or crispate; FOC margin entire.

traits.sexual_system.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus (Mosyakin & Robertson) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): monoecious in subgenera Amaranthus and Albersia, dioecious in subgenus Acnida (fewer species). FOC: flowers unisexual, on the same plant or not.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus (Mosyakin & Robertson) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): compound dichasia arranged in spikes, thyrses, panicles or glomerules; FOC clustered at axils and apex in solitary or complex thyrsoid structures.

traits.flowering_position.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus (Mosyakin & Robertson) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences terminal and/or axillary, or terminal only.

traits.perianth.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus (Mosyakin & Robertson) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): tepals 3-5 (pistillate flowers absent or (1-)3-5); FOC tepals 5, rarely 1-4.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus (Mosyakin & Robertson) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): tepals (1-)3-5; staminate tepals 3-5. Five the commonest (FOC tepals 5, rarely 1-4). The rare single tepal is left out because merosity starts at 2.

traits.stamens.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus (Mosyakin & Robertson) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): staminate flowers with 3-5 stamens; FOC stamens 5, rarely 1-4.

traits.carpels.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus (Mosyakin & Robertson) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stigmas 2-3(-5), one ovule; read as 2-3 carpels.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus (Mosyakin & Robertson) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): utricles opening by a regular lid (circumscissile), bursting irregularly, or staying shut. Lid-opening read as capsule, closed as achene.

traits.calyx_in_fruit.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus (Mosyakin & Robertson) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): utricles loosely enclosed by the inner tepals.
